name: Douglas
text: Superb services as per, Nyam take his time and  seeks customer satisfaction! Friendly staff and great barbers

name: Tunde
text: Absolutely amazing, one of the best haircut I have ever had. Definitely returning!

name: Jordan
text: DOITFORTHEART Best Barber in MK, easy to book and always good vibes in the shop. Would recommend to anyone.

name: Sunny
text: Reception and haircut was top notch, I don’t usually write review but had to give this one a review and I’d recommend it.

name: Mr Douglas
text:
This barbershop is truly a pillar in the community. I’ve been bringing my sons here for years, and the consistency in quality and service is second to none. The attention to detail with every haircut is outstanding, you can tell real pride goes into the work.
The owner is a genuinely special person who creates a welcoming environment for everyone who walks through the door. Whether you’re waiting your turn or sitting in the chair, there’s always a great atmosphere, relaxed, friendly, and full of positive energy.
The whole team deserves credit as well, skilled, professional, and always approachable. It’s rare to find a place that combines top-level service with such a strong community vibe. Highly recommend to anyone looking for more than just a haircut.

name: Franklin
text: Great experience the barber (Jayme) is very accommodating, and asks questions to give you the haircut you want. Good quality and quick experience (around 40 mins)

name: Jonathan
text: Whole team is incredible. Best trims in MK without a shadow of a doubt. Nyam has been my barber for over a year and has never let me down. No one I trust more with my trims

name: Simone
text: Shop is clean, customer service is amazing and everyone is the shop is friendly and very experienced! Highly recommend if you live in Milton Keynes

name: Awais
text:
Do it for the art is easily the best barbershop in mk! Clean, hospitable, talented and friendly service.

Shout out to Nathan (cuts by ns) the goat! 10/10 trims every time.

Can’t recommend this place more

name: Jaheim
text:
The best service, attention to detail, and customer service.

In particular Nathan Sem was amazing, best haircut of my life.

name: IamD4n
text: Great place for a haircut good atmosphere everyone’s chill shout out to JMFADES best at the fade and beard trims 💯

text: The haircut was perfect and he was very kind and welcoming!! I think I found the perfect guy to be doing my hair!  Really happy man!!#THISGUYISTHEBEST

name: Tipsation
text: Quality service each an every time, good people good atmosphere and a pillar of the local community. Couldn’t recommend this place enough and I wish Nyam and the boys all the best.

name: Daniel
text:
I booked an appointment with jai, visited Thursday 22 January. Jai took the time to understand what I wanted and delivered exactly that and more.
Highly recommend jai barbershop
Thank you!

name: Valentine
text: When I tell people I am addicted to Do It For The Art barbers, no one seems to understand.

name: Claude
text: Excellent service, great atmosphere and deep conversations.
